title: Right Destination, Wrong Journey: Synthetic Counseling Dialogues Miss Human Interactional Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.31686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-generated counseling dialogues are increasingly used for training and evaluating mental-health systems, yet existing evaluations focus largely on response quality and final outcomes rather than how support unfolds over time. We conduct a trajectory-centered evaluation of process fidelity across ten human, reconstructed, and synthetic counseling datasets. Our results show that synthetic dialogues often reach plausible endpoints but differ from human support in recovery dynamics and turn-by-turn responsiveness. While generation design can shift global properties such as recovery timing and trajectory structure, contingent patient--counselor responsiveness remains consistently lower in fidelity across models and generation paradigms. Our experiments on controlled synthetic datasets show that targeted generation interventions can narrow the gap with real data on several trajectory-level measures, but do not fully recover interactional

translated_title: 正确的终点，错误的旅程：合成心理咨询对话缺失人类互动动态
translated_abstract: LLM生成的心理咨询对话越来越多地被用于训练和评估心理健康系统，然而现有评估大多聚焦于回复质量和最终结果，而非心理支持如何随时间逐步展开。我们对十个人类、重构以及合成的心理咨询数据集开展了以轨迹为中心的过程保真度评估。结果表明，合成对话往往能够达到看似合理的终点，但在恢复动态和逐轮响应方面与人类支持存在差异。尽管生成设计可以改变恢复时机和轨迹结构等全局属性，但在各类模型和生成范式下，患者与咨询师之间的条件性响应保真度始终较低。我们在受控合成数据集上的实验表明，针对性的生成干预能够在若干轨迹层面的指标上缩小与真实数据的差距，但无法完全恢复人类的互动动态。
tldr: 该研究提出以轨迹为中心的过程保真度评估方法，发现LLM生成的心理咨询对话虽能模拟合理的最终结果，但在恢复动态和逐轮响应等人类互动动态方面保真度不足，且即使采取针对性的生成干预也无法完全恢复这些互动特性。
en_tdlr: Through trajectory-centered evaluation across ten counseling datasets, this paper reveals that LLM-generated counseling dialogues reach plausible endpoints but lack fidelity in human interactional dynamics such as recovery trajectories and turn-by-turn responsiveness, and targeted generation interventions cannot fully recover these dynamics.
